scope: Original level A exercises 51–93, before the 28 screenshot exclusions.
method: Editorial review of the published line and piece placement, with python-chess checking immediate recapture candidates and legality. These checks establish local tactical relationships, not a fresh engine proof of the whole game. Recapture candidates can also be illegal for reasons other than discovered check; reasons are assessed individually.
